copy_source: B v1 board (video/B/board/playback-promo-ja-1080x1920-v1.json): hook, three benefit beats, video line and end-card conditions; price, icon card, gradient background and rounded clip cards dropped for the App Store.
notes: C (paid-launch 2026-10-25): the user adopted B (benefit-first). C keeps B's copy, beat order and project-original music, and meets App Preview rules: every frame is full-screen footage of 1.0.0 (8); no text-only or CG-only scene, no device frame, no rounded card on a synthetic background, no price.

Copy is placed in empty areas of the real screens: the library's empty band below the rows (about 0.43-0.88 of the height without the mini player, 0.44-0.81 with it), the Now Playing sheet's band below the option row (0.89-0.98) and the video sheet's band below the option row (0.75-0.98).

Benefit sentences span two shots: the first half sits on the player (1本終われば、 / 保存しておけば、) and the following library repeats it smaller above the payoff (次の1本へ。 / 電波がなくても。) so each library frame reads as a full sentence without sound.

Hook: the first line (Notionにためた、) is fully visible from frame 0 (start -0.4 s, no rise) on the clean library; the use cases are examples of the viewer's own files; the app ships no content and the end card says so.

Order is not chronological, as in A: c2 (library with the first item playing, 17.3) → c3 (that item ending, 41.6) → c4 (next item playing in the mini player, finished item marked 再生済み, 48.8) → c5 (saving while playing, 34.4) → c6 (both rows 保存済み, 109.0) → c7 (video playing, 55.6) → c8 (clean library, 5.6, dimmed black@0.55). Each shot is shown as recorded; no state is implied that the take does not contain.

Claims and their basis in 1.0.0 (8): continuous playback from the tapped item (AppState queue; c4 shows auto-advance), offline playback of saved files (App Store description; c5/c6 show save → 保存済み), speed menu and sleep timer (PlayerViews.swift), background audio (Info.plist UIBackgroundModes audio). No AI, time-stamped notes, auto-save, new-feature, all-formats, lifetime-update, streaming/DRM or Notion-partnership claims; no price.

End card is the real library (c8) darkened to black@0.55; the conditions (Notion account connection for the viewer's own data, bring your own audio/video, independent of Notion Labs, Inc.) appear at 0.9 s and stay to the last frame (no video fade-out). Music fades out over the last 2.0 s.

Music: playback-original-chord-sketch-30s.m4a (project-original, synthesised with FFmpeg aevalsrc; candidate8/app-preview/media/RIGHTS.md), the same track B uses and the demo library plays. Captured footage audio is never used.
NASA credit (NASA Goddard Space Flight Center) is shown small on the video shot only.
Upscale 480x1040 -> 886x1920 (x1.846, lanczos); UI text in the footage is soft at full size. Copy is rendered at output resolution.
